snippet.title: CARDS OF DESTINY - EARLY ACCESS DATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description:
Cards of Destiny launches in Early Access on August 28. 

Step into a VR tabletop strategy game where your hands control fate itself, using magical one-use cards to save, protect, curse, or sacrifice tiny beings living on your board. Build your deck, shape the battlefield, and survive chaotic challenges where every card can change someone’s destiny. Developed by United Games, Cards of Destiny brings a playful god-game fantasy to VR with hand-driven interactions, strategic choices, and miniature worlds full of big consequences.
